visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Swap Without a Temporary Variable
visualizerParams.problemDescription: This swap uses a temporary variable. Rewrite it with arithmetic so no third variable is needed. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The sum is kept in first, then subtracting the old second leaves the old first in second, and subtracting that from the sum gives the old second. It is a known trick, though with huge values the addition can overflow, so the temporary variable is usually the better choice.
